pitch:
# A booking page for a hair salon

## 1. People and their journey
**Client** (the only role in the interface). Wants to see which times are free and book a service without phoning.
Path: arrives, chooses a service, picks a day, picks a free time, enters name, phone and email, submits, sees a confirmation that the request is "Requested".
Salon staff confirm requests outside the interface; they have no screens here.

## 2. How it looks
A single-column booking page, calm and warm, like a salon's own website: soft cream background, white cards, deep plum accents, rounded corners.

- **Page background**: flat cream (#FAF5EF), full width, content centred in a column about 640px wide.
- **Header**: top of column, flat, plum (#5B2A4E) text with the salon booking title and one line "Book your appointment".
- **Step 1 card, services**: white raised card with soft shadow, titled "Choose a service", holding the service rows.
- **Service row**: outlined grey (#D9CFC6) row showing name, duration and nothing else. Hover: border plum. Selected: plum fill, white text. Focused: plum outline.
- **Step 2 card, day**: white raised card, titled "Choose a day", with a horizontal strip of the next 14 days, each showing weekday and date.
- **Day chip**: outlined grey. Selected: plum fill, white text. Fully booked or closed day: faded, struck through, not clickable. Today carries a small plum dot.
- **Step 3 card, times**: white raised card, titled "Choose a time", showing a grid of time buttons. Before a service and day are chosen it is faded with the text "Pick a service and day first".
- **Time button**: outlined plum, plum text. Hover: light plum fill (#EFE3EC). Selected: plum fill, white text. Taken: grey fill (#EEE9E4), grey text, not clickable.
- **Empty times message**: inside the times card, grey text "No times left this day" when none are free.
- **Step 4 card, details**: white raised card, titled "Your details", with fields Name, Phone, Email, each with a label above.
- **Field**: white, grey outline. Focused: plum outline. Invalid after a submit attempt: red (#B3261E) outline and a short red message below.
- **Summary line**: above the button, plum text, e.g. "Cut · 45 min · Tue 12 May, 10:30". Hidden until a service and time are chosen.
- **Book button**: full-width plum fill, white text, "Request booking". Disabled until service and time are chosen: grey fill. Pressed: darker plum (#431D39). While sending: shows "Sending…" and is disabled.
- **Failure message**: red text above the button when sending fails, "Could not send. Try again."; entries are kept.
- **Confirmation card**: replaces the step cards after success; white raised card with a green (#2E7D4F) tick, the booking summary, a "Requested" badge in amber (#E0A526) with dark text, and a "Book another" button outlined plum.

## 3. How it is used
- Click or tap a service row: selects it; any previously chosen time is cleared.
- Click or tap a day chip: selects the day and loads its free times; clears the chosen time.
- Click or tap a free time button: selects it; tapping it again deselects.
- Click or tap Name, Phone or Email, then type: enters details.
- Click or tap Request booking: checks the entries, then sends the request.
- Press Tab and Enter or Space: reach and activate every choice by keyboard.
- Click or tap Book another: clears everything and returns to step 1.

## 4. Scope
One loop: choose service, day and time, give contact details, submit, see the "Requested" confirmation. No payments, stylists, products or loyalty.

## 5. Things and their states
- **Service**: name, duration in minutes. Fixed list, no states.
- **Time slot**: date, start time, state Free or Taken. Free becomes Taken when a booking requests it.
- **Booking**: service, slot, name, phone, email, status. Starts Requested; staff outside the interface move it to Confirmed. Shown to the client as Requested at submission.

## 6. Rules
- A service, day and time must all be chosen; otherwise the button stays disabled.
- Name is required; empty is refused with "Enter your name".
- Phone is required and must hold at least 7 digits (spaces, +, - allowed); otherwise refused with a message.
- Email must look like name@domain; otherwise refused with a message.
- Slots are offered only in the future and within the next 14 days.
- A Taken slot cannot be selected; clicks are ignored.
- If a slot is taken by someone else before submit, the booking is refused, times refresh, and the message "That time was just taken. Pick another." shows.
- A slot must fit the chosen service's duration; slots that would overrun closing time are not shown.
- Each slot holds one booking only.
- Every new booking has status Requested.
- Changing the service after choosing a time clears the time.
- Double-clicking the button sends only one request.

entities_block:
- **Service** (shown to audience: its records are loaded from the API): [id: string, name: string, duration_minutes: int]
- **TimeSlot** (shown to audience: its records are loaded from the API): [id: string, slot_date: datetime, start_time: datetime, state: string, booking_id: string]
- **Booking** (created by audience): [id: string, service_id: string, time_slot_id: string, client_name: string, client_phone: string, client_email: string, status: string, requested_at: datetime]
action_protocol_block:
The rules the product enforces (plan the audience's side of them; the business's own back-office handling is out of view):
- [Service and time required before booking] (Booking): Given a client on the booking page with no service or no time chosen When the client views the Request booking button Then the button is disabled and grey.
- [Service and time chosen enables submit] (Booking): Given a client has chosen a service and a free time When the client views the Request booking button Then the button is enabled.
- [Name is required] (Booking): Given a client submits a booking with an empty name When the request is checked Then it is refused with 'Enter your name' and no booking is created.
- [Name present accepted] (Booking): Given a client enters a non-empty name When the name is checked Then the name is accepted.
- [Phone must hold at least 7 digits] (Booking): Given a client enters a phone with fewer than 7 digits When the request is checked Then it is refused with a message and no booking is created.
- [Phone with allowed characters accepted] (Booking): Given a client enters '+44 20 7946 0958' When the phone is checked Then it is accepted.
- [Email must look like name@domain] (Booking): Given a client enters an email without '@' or domain When the request is checked Then it is refused with a message and no booking is created.
- [Valid email accepted] (Booking): Given a client enters 'ana@example.com' When the email is checked Then it is accepted.
- [Offer only future slots] (TimeSlot): Given a time slot whose start is before now When the client views available times Then the slot is not offered.
- [Offer slots within next 14 days only] (TimeSlot): Given a day more than 14 days from today When the client views the day strip Then that day is not offered.
- [Taken slot cannot be selected] (TimeSlot): Given a time slot in state Taken When the client clicks it Then the selection does not change.
- [Free slot can be selected] (TimeSlot): Given a time slot in state Free When the client clicks it twice Then it is selected then deselected.
- [Slot taken by another before submit refuses booking] (Booking): Given a client has chosen a slot that another booking has taken When the client submits Then no booking is created, the times refresh and 'That time was just taken. Pick another.' is shown.
- [Slot transitions Free to Taken on request] (TimeSlot): Given a Free time slot When a booking request for it is accepted Then the slot state becomes Taken.
- [Each slot holds one booking] (TimeSlot): Given a time slot already held by a booking When another booking requests it Then the second request is refused.
- [Slot must fit service duration before closing] (TimeSlot): Given a 45-minute service and a slot starting 30 minutes before closing When the client views times Then that slot is not shown.
- [Every new booking starts Requested] (Booking): Given a valid booking submission When the booking is created Then its status is Requested and the confirmation shows 'Requested'.
- [Changing service clears chosen time] (Booking): Given a client has chosen a service and a time When the client selects a different service Then the chosen time is cleared.
- [Choosing a day clears chosen time] (TimeSlot): Given a client has chosen a time When the client selects a day chip Then the chosen time is cleared and that day's free times load.
- [Double submit sends one request] (Booking): Given a booking request is being sent When the client clicks Request booking again Then no second booking request is created.
- [Failed send keeps entries] (Booking): Given a client submits and sending fails When the failure occurs Then no booking is created, 'Could not send. Try again.' is shown and the entered details remain.
- [Successful submit shows Requested confirmation] (Booking): Given a booking was created successfully When the client sees the page Then the confirmation card shows the summary and a 'Requested' badge.
- [Summary line shown only when complete] (Booking): Given a client has chosen a service and a time When the summary line is viewed Then it shows the service, duration and date and time.
- [Invalid fields flagged after submit attempt] (Booking): Given a client attempted to submit with an invalid field When the form is shown Then that field has a red outline and a message below it.
- [Times card empty message] (TimeSlot): Given a chosen day with no free times When the times card is shown Then it displays 'No times left this day'.
- [Times card faded until service and day chosen] (TimeSlot): Given no service or no day is chosen When the times card is viewed Then it is faded and shows 'Pick a service and day first'.
- [Fully booked or closed day not selectable] (TimeSlot): Given a day with no free slots or closed When the day strip is shown Then the day is faded, struck through and not clickable.
- [Keyboard reachability of choices] (Booking): Given a client uses only the keyboard When they press Tab and Enter or Space Then every choice can be reached and activated.
- [Book another resets booking] (Booking): Given the confirmation is shown When the client clicks Book another Then all selections and entries are cleared and step 1 is shown.
- [Staff confirmation moves Requested to Confirmed] (Booking): Given a booking with status Requested When staff confirm it outside the interface Then its status becomes Confirmed.
intent_block:
- Product type: customer_app
- Audience: Hair salon clients booking appointments
- Goal: Let clients see available appointment times and book a hair salon service without phoning the salon.
- Scope: A single booking page where clients choose a service and time slot and submit their contact details to create a booking.
- The model must cover: Services offered and their durations; Available appointment time slots; Client booking requests with contact details; Booking status (requested or confirmed)
- Do NOT model: Staff rosters and stylist assignment; Online payments and deposits; Inventory and product sales; Client loyalty programmes
